end if main then main.Visible = true end end end) ---------------------------------------------------------- -- CORE SYSTEM FUNCTIONS ---------------------------------------------------------- local function sendBlueChatMessage(msgText) pcall(function() if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then local generalChannel =
